rules.statement: An alienation in fraud of creditors is not ipso jure void and is valid unless it is set aside within the prescriptive period.
rules.supporting_quote: "an alienation in fraud of creditors is not ipso jure void and is valid unless it is set aside within the prescriptive period"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: [1 Section 10, Prescription Ordinance. Ahamado Lebbe et al. v. Adam Bawa et al., 3 A. C. R. 1]
